the development of the PMSMServo drive with SFC and MPAC based constrained control.
the development of a novel approach for the control of PMSM servo drives.
the application of model predictive control (MPC) for PMSM servo drives with SFC.

the proposed control system with MPAC is able to provide high performance servo drive with constrained position control.

the presented approach provides a simple and efficient way to handle constraints in the control of PMSM drives with SFC.

the MPAC can provide a good alternative for the conventional PID control in PMSM servo drives.
